skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Use when Codex or Claude Code should delegate repository exploration or implementation to Google Antigravity CLI (agy), then review, verify, repair, and deliver the result.
skill.summary: Delegate repository tasks to Antigravity CLI, then review candidate changes and record independent verification.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: Most supplied alerts match validation, documentation, or controlled runtime operations; confirmed verifier execution risks remain. Session-mode authority and broad native Keychain/network grants require explicit review; no evidence found of malicious intent or audit-directed prompt injection. The static cap leaves 263 additional matches unadjudicated, so this report does not establish publication clearance. Static review was capped at 400/663 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 263 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Session staging does not enforce approved provider read boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit session-risk acknowledgement, or use supported native containment or a separate restricted account for sensitive repositories.

remediation.issue: Driver verification executes untrusted candidate code with host authority.
remediation.suggestion: Run candidate checks in an OS-isolated workspace with denied network and no credentials. Keep candidate snapshots as integrity evidence, not containment.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain permissions allow operations beyond provider authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated provider-only Keychain or a narrow authentication broker. Avoid exposing general security-helper operations to worker processes.

remediation.issue: Native provider networking permits unrestricted remote port 443 destinations and potentially wildcard listeners.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce reviewed destinations through an egress proxy or network policy. Restrict listeners to loopback or remove unnecessary inbound permissions.

remediation.issue: The supplied static catalog covers only 400 of 663 matches.
remediation.suggestion: Have a reviewer adjudicate the remaining 263 matches before automatic publication. Do not treat this capped review as a complete security clearance.

semantic_findings.title: Native Keychain Grants Exceed Provider Authentication
semantic_findings.description: Native mode authorizes Keychain services for the provider and security helper. Helper arguments and credential items remain unrestricted, enabling broader same-user credential operations.

semantic_findings.title: Native Network Grants Are Not Recipient-Restricted

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Work and Verify Results
content.value_statement: Delegated coding can produce changes without reliable acceptance evidence. This skill coordinates Antigravity tasks, approved content scopes, independent checks, and recorded final dispositions.
actual_capabilities: Coordinate explore, task, and project workflows with bounded cycle and time budgets.
Preview and bind approved tasks, provider-readable content, model choices, and launch settings before dispatch.
Stage selected content and reconcile authorized changes through scoped read and write policies.
Track candidate digests, job status, recovery actions, and same-conversation repairs.
Validate worker reports and bind driver-owned verification receipts before finalization.
Support optional network-free advisory checks through native containment on supported macOS hosts.
limitations: Live delegation requires Bash, Python 3, Git, and Antigravity CLI with provider access.
Default session mode is not host isolation; native containment requires a compatible macOS environment.
Driver verification can execute untrusted candidate code; ordinary verification copies are not OS sandboxes.
Offline readiness, worker reports, and passing gates do not prove complete correctness or provider authentication.

use_cases.title: Add Focused Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Delegate test changes within reviewed paths, inspect the diff, and verify the parser behavior independently.

use_cases.title: Explore an Unfamiliar Repository
use_cases.description: Delegate bounded architecture exploration, spot-check reported findings, and record remaining coverage gaps.

use_cases.title: Review a Multi-Step Project Candidate
use_cases.description: Coordinate approved project changes, bounded repairs, and independent build, test, and lint evidence before recording a final disposition.

prompt_templates.title: Check Offline Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Do not launch a provider task or inspect account settings. Report missing prerequisites.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: confirm local tools before delegation.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Repository Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an explore preview for [repository] using only [reviewed paths]. Show the exact task, content scope, isolation, model, and budget for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a bounded exploration request.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate a Bounded Test Change
prompt_templates.prompt: After my exact launch approval, delegate [test task] with writes limited to [test paths]. Review the diff and independently select verification checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: delegate implementation while retaining acceptance authority.

prompt_templates.title: Repair and Finalize a Bound Candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [job] and its current candidate digest. Use approved same-conversation repair for [sanitized failures] within budget. Bind fresh driver evidence and finalize honestly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: recover a candidate without changing approved exposure.

output_examples.input: Report a reviewed test candidate with one unavailable check.

Preview prepared for the selected source and test paths.
Launch requires approval of the exact task, scope, isolation, model, and budget bound by the preview digest.

best_practices: Review exact provider-readable content and launch settings before approval; exclude secrets, private logs, and unrelated files.
Inspect the bound candidate diff and run reviewed checks in OS-isolated verification environments without credentials.
Preserve current digests, approved budgets, and same-conversation repair lineage; record unresolved gaps in the final disposition.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, a digest, or offline readiness as authorization to transmit repository content.
Executing worker-reported commands or trusting worker reports as independent acceptance evidence.
Weakening gates, widening exposure, or silently switching isolation and repair policies after failure.

faq.question: Which assistant hosts are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports OpenAI Codex CLI and Claude Code as driver hosts. Live work is delegated through Antigravity CLI.

faq.question: Does installation authorize provider transmission?
faq.answer: No. Live dispatch requires approval of the exact task, provider-readable content, launch settings, model choice, and budget.

faq.question: Is a scoped stage a security sandbox?
faq.answer: No. Session mode retains normal user authority. Native containment adds restrictions only on supported macOS hosts and still has documented limits.

faq.question: Who decides whether changes are accepted?
faq.answer: The driver reviews the actual diff and supplies independent verification evidence. Worker reports and optional advisory checks do not own acceptance.

faq.question: Can failed checks trigger repairs?
faq.answer: Approved same-conversation repairs can run within the recorded scope and budget. Changed exposure or permissions require fresh authority.

faq.question: Does finalization commit or publish changes?
faq.answer: No. Finalization records the driver disposition. Commits, pushes, merges, releases, and publication require separate authority.
